question: Which Indian footballer was honoured as the Promising Men's Player of the Year at the AIFF Awards 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brison Fernandes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** announced its annual awards for the **2023-24** season at a ceremony held in **early 2025**, recognizing excellence across various categories in Indian football.
 
• **Brison Fernandes**, a talented midfielder playing for **FC Goa**, was officially named the **Promising Men's Player of the Year**.
 
• This award is given to young players who have shown exceptional performance and growth in domestic leagues like the **Indian Super League (ISL)** and national team age-group tournaments.
 
• The **AIFF Awards** serve as the highest individual recognition in Indian football, with winners selected based on their contribution to their respective clubs and the **Indian National Team**.
 
• The recognition of **Brison Fernandes** highlights the success of the youth development programs in **Goa** and the **ISL**, marking him as a future star for the senior national squad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Major Winners at AIFF Awards 2025:**
 
 
• **Lallianzuala Chhangte**: He was awarded the **AIFF Men’s Player of the Year** for the second year in a row for his outstanding clinical performance with **Mumbai City FC** and the national team.
 
• **Indumathi Kathiresan**: She secured the **AIFF Women’s Player of the Year** title, reflecting her leadership and skill in the **Indian Women's League (IWL)**.
 
 
 
• **Profiles of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Subhasish Bose**: A veteran defender and captain of **Mohun Bagan Super Giant**, he was recognized as the **Best Defender** of the season for his consistent backline leadership.
 
• **Vishal Kaith**: The **Mohun Bagan** shot-stopper was awarded the **Best Goalkeeper** award, following his high number of clean sheets and vital saves in the **ISL** and **Durand Cup**.
 
• **Khalid Jamil**: Currently the head coach of **Jamshedpur FC**, he was honoured as the **Men's Coach of the Year**, becoming a prominent figure for Indian coaches in top-tier football.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the AIFF:**
 
 
• The **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** was founded in **1937** and is the governing body for association football in India.
 
• Headquartered in **New Delhi**, it manages the **Indian National Team**, the **Indian Super League**, and the **I-League**, while being a member of **FIFA** and the **Asian Football Confederation (AFC)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **AIFF Awards** are usually determined by a voting process involving head coaches of the **Indian Super League (ISL)** and the **I-League** clubs.
 
• The **2025 awards** ceremony emphasized the **Vision 2047** roadmap, which aims to make India a powerhouse in Asian football by the centenary of its independence.
 
• The **Promising Women's Player of the Year** for the same period was awarded to **Neha**, a rising talent from **Haryana** playing in the women's leagues.
